value.title: Failed track writes and Stop retain the shared-store tail
value.statement: Map/menu/notification require confirmation before recording Stop; Cancel/Back preserve intent. A durable user-session UUID rejects stale confirmations and survives recovery/split. Sampled points enter a bounded ordered application-owned shared-track queue before idempotent UUID SQLite insert. A failed write retains the point; pending files are removed only after commit. Stop intent, track row and recording flag survive until the full tail drains and session closure commits. Corrupt checkpoints block silent recovery. Disk-full RAM fallback cannot survive process death until durable persistence succeeds; this limit must remain explicit.
